title: Blue Exorcist
source: Blue Exorcist manga by Kazue Kato (ongoing). Snapshots use the latest published arc.
world: Rin Okumura learns he is the son of Satan when blue flames burst out of him and his adoptive father, the exorcist Shiro Fujimoto, dies protecting him. Rin enrols at True Cross Academy with his twin brother Yukio to become an exorcist and beat Satan. His classmates slowly learn to trust him despite his demon blood. Shonen action with family drama.
power_system: Exorcists fight demons from Gehenna in classes like Knight, Dragoon, Tamer, Doctor and Aria. Rin's blue flames come from Satan and are sealed in the sword Kurikara; drawing it releases his demon form.
